subject: DESIGN: unify the node lifecycle into ONE ingestion→embed→wire→judge→ready→dispatch path (kill all bypasses)
description:
EPIC ENTRY POINT (design/inventory only — do NOT implement the refactor here). User vision (2026-06-14): one canonical path for every node, no special lanes. Everything that enters → becomes a graph node → embed → wire (recall) → judge → ready (gated on judged) → auto-dispatch by the loop. The loop is the single engine; the daemon must NOT pick up native tasks a different way.

Today there are MULTIPLE paths that skip parts of the pipe; "one path" means cataloguing and killing each bypass. This task produces the map + the target pipeline + the deletion list + the ordered build decomposition. Capture as a design note (record_decision) + wire the decomposed build tasks into the graph.

DELIVERABLE 1 — INVENTORY every path (read the code, list precisely):
- Every way a node is BORN: native TaskCreate adoption (lib/native-tasks.js adoptNativeTask + daemon.js buildGraph adopt-on-first-sight); file-drop mints (lib/filedrop-tasks.js); daemon follow-ups (lib/followups.js, followup-buckets.js); MCP create (orchestrator-graph TaskCreate, record_decision→/overlay/note); note creation (routes/overlay.js /overlay/note).
- Every way a node reaches READY / gets DISPATCHED: the loop/decideAll spawn path (daemon.js decideOne/decideAll); D's judging→ready gate (lib/judge.js judgingState, daemon effective()); any path that makes a node ready WITHOUT going through embed→wire→judge.
- For EACH path, note which steps it SKIPS (embed / B-recall / eager-judge mark / D-gate). The native-task path is the known offender: adopted as a todo, dispatched directly, never embedded/wired/judged.

DELIVERABLE 2 — TARGET single pipeline: define one ingestNode(node) that EVERY entry point funnels through: create graph node → embed (vec, Step-0 path) → fire autowireNewTaskWholeGraph (B, seed weight-0 candidates) → markEagerJudge → (loop dispatches eager judge, task /26) → D-gate holds not_ready until wirings judged → loop auto-dispatches ready. No node reaches `ready` except through judged.

DELIVERABLE 3 — DELETIONS: list the exact bypass code to remove/reroute — the direct native-task-as-ready adoption, lazy embed-on-/overlay/status (move embed to ingest), and any dispatch path not gated on judged-ready.

DELIVERABLE 4 — DECOMPOSITION: ordered build tasks wired into the graph, e.g.: (1) ingestNode() unify + embed-on-create; (2) ready-only-via-judged (close the native bypass); (3) loop-default = existing /26; (4) eager-mark lease = existing /27; (5) fold file-drop + follow-ups into ingestNode. Sequence them (e.g. ingest-unify → ready-gate-close → /27 → /26).

TRADEOFFS to resolve explicitly in the design:
- COST/LATENCY floor: every node now pays embed+recall+judge before it's workable. Confirm acceptable — managed by loop-eager dispatch + D's timeout fallback + the loop's slack-budget. The payoff is the guarantee that a worker claiming ANY task gets a judged DAG context (native tasks don't today).
- Cross-cutting: touches native-tasks.js, filedrop-tasks.js, followups.js, the embed trigger, B, D, the loop. Sequence to avoid a broken intermediate state.

Existing pieces this UNIFIES (not rebuilds): embed=Step 0 (/7), wire=B (/15), eager-judge=C (/16), gate=D (/17), DAG-only consume=E (/18), loop-default=/26, lease=/27. The design slots these into one pipe + removes the bypasses.

summary:
DESIGN+INVENTORY done (no code refactored). Full design in note:note-mqeapqae6jf (wired to /28).

HEADLINE FINDING: 4 distinct born-paths, 1 dispatch gate, and the bypass is structural. Born-paths: (1) native TaskCreate adoption (buildGraph adopt-on-first-sight daemon.js:1467-1469), (2) file-drop mints (lib/filedrop-tasks.js), (3) follow-ups (lib/followups.js apply L85-96), (4) note nodes (/overlay/note L317). Dispatch gate: decideOne spawn pool (daemon.js:866 status===ready), status from effective() incl the D-gate (daemon.js:1350-1351). THE BYPASS: embed+autowire+markEagerJudge live ONLY in /overlay/status (routes/overlay.js:198-218, gated on first vec). Native/file-drop/follow-up tasks get their first /overlay/status write at the in_progress CLAIM — so they reach ready and dispatch with NO vec, NO autowire edges, NO eager mark; judge.judgingState keys on unverifiedEdgesForNode, so zero edges => judging:false => D-gate is a no-op for the entire native lane. OPEN QUESTION RESOLVED: MCP-TaskCreate native tasks enter embed->wire->judge ONLY when a /overlay/status write seeds a vec (the claim), never BEFORE becoming workable. Live proof: the 3 build tasks I minted adopted as ready/judging:false/vecs:null. Bonus dead-code: autowireNoteProvider (daemon.js:1203) has zero production callers.

TARGET: one ingestNode() funnel (embed -> autowireNewTaskWholeGraph -> markEagerJudge+judgingSince) called at BIRTH from buildGraph adoption + followups.apply + note route; /overlay/status keeps only summary-change re-embed; existing D-gate then covers every lane uniformly.

BUILD TASKS CREATED + WIRED (blocking chain): unify/ingest-node-unify (BUILD1, ready) -> unify/ready-only-via-judged (BUILD2) -> existing /27 (lease) -> existing /26 (loop-default) -> unify/fold-filedrop-followups (BUILD3).
